description.value: Urban Gate is a family-owned Persian specialty market that has operated since 2010, offering a full-service butcher, daily-fresh produce, and a bakery producing Persian pastries alongside custom cakes. It also runs a takeout kitchen serving classic Persian grilled dishes and stews. Touring cyclists will find a well-stocked boutique grocery stop with a notably broad selection of specialty and organic items beyond standard supermarket fare.

address.value: #104 - 1158 The High Street, Coquitlam, BC V3B 0C6
